item.title: New battle over Iowa Beverage Containers Control Law
item.description: There's a new fight over Iowa's Beverage Containers Control Law, which helps reduce and clean up litter by recovering beverage containers for recycling. The 'bottle bill' dictates consumers pay a five-cent deposit when purchasing a beverage container and receive a five-cent refund when returning the container to a store or redemption center.
